cases.text: The consolidated financial statements are prepared in Canadian dollars in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards, as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board. A note discusses differences from U.S. GAAP for an unrelated comparison.
The common stock is listed on Nasdaq. A risk factor discusses American Depositary Shares issued by unrelated foreign companies.
The American Depositary Shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange. The consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
The common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange under STN. The financial statements are presented under IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the IASB.

cases.statement: Nasdaq notified the Company that Rule 5550(b)(1), the stockholders' equity requirement, remains under review. Nasdaq also stated that Rule 5550(a)(2), the minimum bid requirement, was closed.

cases.text: The consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. The consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the IASB.
Our audited financial statements are presented in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the IASB. Supplemental discussion explains that no U.S. GAAP reconciliation is required.
The ordinary shares are traded on Nasdaq. Holders should not assume the protections sometimes associated with American Depositary Shares.
The audit committee reviewed a U.S. GAAP checklist. No authoritative financial-statement basis declaration is present.

cases.statement: Rule 5550(a)(2), the minimum bid requirement, is historical and closed. Rule 5550(b)(1), the stockholders' equity requirement, remains active while the plan is reviewed.

cases.text: The audited financial statements are presented in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards as issued by IASB. An unrelated market overview refers to ADR and U.S. GAAP conventions.
The ADSs are traded on Nasdaq. A risk section describes IFRS Accounting Standards without stating that the financial statements use them.
